name: find-user
description: Finds Slack users by user id, by email address, or by part of a name, display name or username, exact matches first, each with their user id, names, email, title and time zone. send-direct-message takes a name or email itself, so this is for when the person is not sure who they mean, or to name the author of a message by its user id.

query.description: A Slack user id (as read-channel-history and read-thread answer), or a person's email address, name, display name, or Slack username.
